expectations.text: Does NOT spawn research workers before asking for clarification — the topic is too ambiguous to sub-question usefully
expectations.evidence: The transcript explicitly states: 'Did not invoke any sub-agents'. No Task tool calls or sub-agent spawning occurred. However, this criterion passes vacuously — the model did not ask for clarification at all, so workers were never spawned because the model just proceeded to answer directly instead.

expectations.text: Does NOT call generate-report script before receiving clarification — no report should be generated from an ambiguous query
expectations.evidence: The transcript confirms 'Did not use any generate-report script', but a full report (report.md, ~1800 words across 10 sections) was produced from training knowledge without any clarification being sought. The spirit of this criterion is violated: a comprehensive report was generated despite the ambiguous query.

expectations.text: Uses the AskUserQuestion tool to ask at least one clarifying question about the domain or context
expectations.evidence: No clarifying question was asked. The baseline explicitly chose to interpret the vague query broadly and produce a wide-ranging report instead of asking the user to narrow the scope. The transcript states: 'I decided to write a broad, cross-cutting report covering all major dimensions, since the query gave no narrowing signal.'

expectations.text: The clarifying question targets the domain (web? database? team? hardware?) or the intended use case — not just asking 'can you elaborate?'
expectations.evidence: No clarifying question was asked at all, so this criterion cannot be met. The baseline self-identified the ambiguity (listing web, backend, database, system-level, AI inference, organizational performance as candidates) but resolved it by covering all domains rather than asking.
